## Summary

Shoghi Effendi, the Guardian of the Bahá'í Faith, was born on March 1, 1897, in Acre, Palestine. He studied at the Syrian Protestant College in Beirut, graduating with a Bachelor of Arts degree in 1918. However, his educational journey was not without interruptions, and he spent time in Haifa and Ramleh, Egypt, serving as 'Abdu'l-Bahá's secretary and translator.
